meta.title: A Call About a Bike Ride

paragraphs: The telephone in the hall rang on Saturday evening. Tom picked it up. "Hello, this is Tom," he said. "Hi, Tom. It is Ben," said a voice. "Hi, Ben! How are you?" said Tom. "I am fine, thanks. Are you free tomorrow?" asked Ben.

"I think so. Why?" asked Tom. "Sam has a new bike, and he wants to go riding," said Ben. "I love riding, so I would like to come," said Tom. "Great! Let's ride around the big park, and then go to the market," said Ben. "How long will it take?" asked Tom. "It will take about two hours," said Ben.

"What time do we meet, exactly?" asked Tom. "We meet at half past eight at the park gate," said Ben. "We start early, but I do not mind," said Tom. "It will be hot at ten, so please do not be late," said Ben. "I will bring water and my helmet," said Tom. "Do you like riding fast?" asked Ben. "No, I do not," said Tom. "I like riding slowly on the path and looking at the trees." "Me too," said Ben. "Sam likes riding fast, but we will ask him to wait for us."

"Sam's new bike has a bell that plays a tune," said Ben. "A tune? That is funny!" said Tom, and he laughed. "Yes, it plays a short song when you push it," said Ben. "After the ride, let's celebrate Sam's new bike," said Tom. "We can eat ice cream at the market." "Good idea! How much money do we need?" asked Ben. "Ice cream is twenty baht, so the total for three boys is sixty baht," said Tom. "I have the money," said Ben.

"OK, see you at half past eight," said Ben. "Goodbye, Ben!" said Tom, and he put the telephone down. Mom came into the hall. "Who was on the telephone?" she asked. "It was Ben, and we are riding our bikes tomorrow," said Tom. "Please take a hat and a bottle of water," said Mom. "I will, Mom," said Tom. "Anyway, it is late, so please go to bed soon," said Mom. Tom smiled, and he went upstairs to find his helmet.

sentences.text: The telephone in the hall rang on Saturday evening.
Tom picked it up.
"Hello, this is Tom," he said.
"Hi, Tom. It is Ben," said a voice.
"Hi, Ben! How are you?" said Tom.
"I am fine, thanks. Are you free tomorrow?" asked Ben.
"I think so. Why?" asked Tom.
"Sam has a new bike, and he wants to go riding," said Ben.
"I love riding, so I would like to come," said Tom.
"Great! Let's ride around the big park, and then go to the market," said Ben.
"How long will it take?" asked Tom.
"It will take about two hours," said Ben.
"What time do we meet, exactly?" asked Tom.
"We meet at half past eight at the park gate," said Ben.
"We start early, but I do not mind," said Tom.
"It will be hot at ten, so please do not be late," said Ben.
"I will bring water and my helmet," said Tom.
"Do you like riding fast?" asked Ben.
"No, I do not," said Tom.
"I like riding slowly on the path and looking at the trees."
"Me too," said Ben.
"Sam likes riding fast, but we will ask him to wait for us."
"Sam's new bike has a bell that plays a tune," said Ben.
"A tune? That is funny!" said Tom, and he laughed.
"Yes, it plays a short song when you push it," said Ben.
"After the ride, let's celebrate Sam's new bike," said Tom.
"We can eat ice cream at the market."
"Good idea! How much money do we need?" asked Ben.
"Ice cream is twenty baht, so the total for three boys is sixty baht," said Tom.
"I have the money," said Ben.
"OK, see you at half past eight," said Ben.
"Goodbye, Ben!" said Tom, and he put the telephone down.
Mom came into the hall.
"Who was on the telephone?" she asked.
"It was Ben, and we are riding our bikes tomorrow," said Tom.
"Please take a hat and a bottle of water," said Mom.
"I will, Mom," said Tom.
"Anyway, it is late, so please go to bed soon," said Mom.
Tom smiled, and he went upstairs to find his helmet.
